terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run uvicorn server.app:app --reload --reload-dir server --reload-dir lib --host 0.0.0.0 --port 1241

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 && cd frontend && pnpm dev --host
